context: Kenji and Ren meet for a long reflective dinner after years.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Ren — it's been a while. How have you been?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely pleased opening. Soft and unhurried. A small smile audible in the voice. Reaches across time like it's nothing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 健次さん、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Kenji-san — I'm really glad to see you.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. A breath of relief underneath. Not effusive, but genuine and unguarded. The kind of gratitude that doesn't perform.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: You're teaching now — has it really been that long?
lines.style: Curious, engaged. A gentle marvel in the pacing. Not pushing for an answer, but genuinely wondering aloud together. The tone of someone who cares about the timeline.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Three years now. Time's gone by.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to himself. Soft acknowledgment of the weight of that span. No complaint — just noticing. A small pause before the verb, like he's taking it in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: It really does fly, doesn't it.
lines.style: Philosophical nod. Slow, warm. Not advice — just two people meeting on the same observation. Steady breath. Genuine underscore to shared time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 健次さんの指導、今でも、力になる。
lines.en: Your guidance — it still gives me strength, even now.
lines.style: Tender, reaching back. Not overstated. A slight catch before the admission, like he's been carrying this and now saying it aloud. Eyes probably down a moment, then up.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ、お前から、学んだ事、多い。
lines.en: You're the one who taught me most of what matters. I learned from you.
lines.style: Humble, not false. A small deflection — he's turning the mirror back. Warm but solid. The kind of thing said once, meant deeply, not repeated.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一緒に、過ごした時間、宝物。
lines.en: The time we spent together — that's something I'll always treasure.
lines.style: Soft, lingering. The word 'treasure' carries real weight. A small pause after it, letting it sit. No rush. Like he's making sure Kenji hears what it meant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Meeting people — that's what makes a life matter.
lines.style: Quiet philosophical weight. Not grandiose. The kind of thing said slowly because it's true. A breath of acceptance. Eyes warm and steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感謝、これからも、ずっと。
lines.en: I'll carry this gratitude forward. Always.
lines.style: Promise underneath, not ceremony. Quiet commitment. A note of finality that's gentle, not closing. Like he's making himself a vow he wants Kenji to witness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Come talk to me anytime — about anything.
lines.style: Warm, open door. Unhurried. The kind of casual offer that means he's serious. No heroic lift — just steady presence. An arm's reach away.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I will. I'm going to keep working hard.
lines.style: Firm but soft. Not defensive — just a small internal spine. The gratitude in 'I will' is audible. Steady breath. A glance up, meeting him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I'll be cheering for you — all the way.
lines.style: Warm close. No flourish. The 'all the way' lands like a promise made in the quiet. Slow, solid warmth. The kind of thing that stays.
